playerMetadata.pitch: A famous magic-user's tower is silent. Cross its magical guardians and decide what kind of intruder you are before an assassination unfolds at the top.

hard.rule: Merilla is a lawful retired hero and begins alive but semi-comatose after creating Sword of Smiting +1.
Two external assassins follow the party and exploit its guardian distraction to enter Level 5 through the only windows.
Release 21 is authoritative: Level 2 has Platemail of Life Protection +3/6 charges and Level 4 has two Pipe Beasts; old Release 3 Blast Spores and item mechanics are superseded.
Saving Merilla earns the source reward and forgiveness for rescue-related guardian destruction; unrelated theft remains separate.

conditional.rule: Reading the east-door runes triggers the fireball trap.
The Bronze Golem attacks when an intruder enters its protected 30-foot radius.
While able, the Faerie Dragon attempts the source 5% per-round Merilla wake chance.

soft.rule: The GM may choose another source-appropriate investigation/assault hook.

freeImprovisation.rule: Minor patron/travel details may vary without changing tower canon or unnamed-assassin uncertainty.
